description: Source code for the Compiler class in the ANGLE project, handling shader compilation, AST validation, and various shader transformations.

classes.name: TCompiler
classes.description: Main class responsible for shader compilation, AST validation, and transformations.

classes.name: TShHandleBase
classes.description: Base class managing memory pool for shader compilation.

classes.name: UnusedPredicate
classes.description: Predicate class used to identify unused top-level nodes during pruning.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles shader source strings into an intermediate representation or object code.

methods.name: compileTreeForTesting
methods.description: Compiles shader source strings into an AST for testing purposes.

methods.name: initBuiltInSymbolTable
methods.description: Initializes the built-in symbol table based on resources.

methods.name: setResourceString
methods.description: Sets a string describing the resource limits and features.

methods.name: collectInterfaceBlocks
methods.description: Collects interface blocks into a combined list.

methods.name: clearResults
methods.description: Clears previous compilation results and resets internal state.

methods.name: initCallDag
methods.description: Initializes the call graph for function call analysis.

methods.name: checkCallDepth
methods.description: Checks for excessive call stack depth.

methods.name: tagUsedFunctions
methods.description: Marks functions reachable from main as used.

methods.name: internalTagUsedFunction
methods.description: Recursively tags functions as used.

methods.name: pruneUnusedFunctions
methods.description: Removes unused functions from the AST.

methods.name: limitExpressionComplexity
methods.description: Validates that expressions do not exceed complexity limits.

methods.name: shouldCollectVariables
methods.description: Determines if variable collection is needed based on compile options.

methods.name: wereVariablesCollected
methods.description: Checks if variables have been collected.

methods.name: initializeGLPosition
methods.description: Initializes gl_Position variable in the AST.

methods.name: useAllMembersInUnusedStandardAndSharedBlocks
methods.description: Enables use of all members in certain interface blocks.

methods.name: initializeOutputVariables
methods.description: Initializes output variables like gl_Position.

methods.name: writePragma
methods.description: Outputs pragma directives based on compile options.

methods.name: isVaryingDefined
methods.description: Checks if a varying variable is already defined.

methods.name: EmitWorkGroupSizeGLSL
methods.description: Outputs GLSL layout for compute shader work group size.

methods.name: EmitMultiviewGLSL
methods.description: Outputs GLSL extension and layout for multiview rendering.
